newsitem.title: USA: Rexene sees Q1 cut by high feedstock prices.
newsitem.headline: Rexene sees Q1 cut by high feedstock prices.

text.p: Rexene Corp said Wednesday it foresaw higher costs for feedstocks bought during the last two months having a "negative effect" on first-quarter results.
"We are ...seeing some moderation in feedstock costs (this year) ...However, higher costs for December and January will have a negative effect on first quarter results," it said.
The company also said prices would rise for polyethylene, polypropylene and styrene product lines in 1997.

It said it expected to double production at its new REXflex polymer plant by the middle of the year. The plant has begun producing at an annualized rate of about 35 million pounds, compared to a capacity of 75 million pounds.
"We anticipate that the effect of these price increases and added (production) capacity, while positive for Rexene in 1997, will be marginal in the first quarter," it said.
The company reported fourth-quarter results of $0.37 a share against $0.42 a year ago.
Based in Dallas, Texas, Rexene makes thermoplastic resins and petrochemical products including polyethylene and polypropylene resins and plastic film.
